title: Round comments
description: A reviewer's comments, a person's or an agent's, on one round of a design: `<design folder>/rounds/<design name>/<N>/comments.json`, where the design name is the file's stem. The viewer writes a person's file (Download, or Copy the JSON), and `open-prototype save-comments` saves it. The viewer lists the comments of earlier rounds beside the design. `limits` is the one table the viewer, the save, and the build read: nothing is ever cut in silence.

items.comment: Say which items the button saves.

schema_version.description: The version of the round files, apart from the version of what the tool prints. The viewer and the save write it; a file without it reads as 1. A newer one asks for a newer tool, and the check leaves the file out.

round.description: The round's number, the `<N>` of its folder.

items.description: The comments, in the order they were made.

id.description: The comment's id, `r<round>-<n>`, where `<round>` is the round of the file that holds it. A later round's `changes.json` names it in `answers`.

type.description: What the comment asks for: change, remove, or add something, or a question. A file without it reads as change.

screen.description: The screen the comment was made on, by its `data-proto-screen` id.

state.description: The state the screen showed, by its `data-proto-state` name.

testid.description: The `data-testid` of the element the comment is about.

index.description: Which of the visible elements that share the test id, counting from 0, when several do, such as one card of a list.

box.description: Where the element showed in the frame's view when the comment was made, in CSS pixels from the frame's top left.

comment.description: What the reviewer said, in their words: text, tabs, and line breaks, and no other control character.

frame.description: The device frame the comment was made in, as the viewer's `frame=` key names it.

theme.description: The theme setting the comment was made in: light, dark, or system.

shown_theme.description: The theme the view showed when the comment was made: the theme the reviewer saw, even when the viewer followed the system.

link.description: The viewer's deep link to the view the comment was made on.

by.description: Who wrote the comment: an agent writes `agent:<harness>/<model>`. The viewer writes none, so an item without `by` is a person's. It is a label the writer gave, never proof, and it decides nothing.
